channel.desc: Action 2021 In 1839, a former soldier leaves England and embarks on a journey to discover Borneo Island in Southeast Asia. Later, he finds himself responsible for clearing it of slavery and beheading. Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Josie Ho, Dominic Monaghan, Ralph Ineson, Hannah New, Michael Haussman, Rob Allyn.
